title: Commutative algebra for deformation theory and patching, Part II: Kawasaki’s Cohen–Macaulay blowing-ups
summary: This continuation starts after the finite-module depth, support and Cohen–Macaulay theory of DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra R03.3. It develops ordered CM-secant and Huneke d-sequences, Kawasaki’s product-of-prefix-ideals calculus and blowing-ups of modules. The final target is a Cohen–Macaulay module blowing-up along the ideal determined by a CM-secant sequence, with the actual local-cohomology claims and dimension bound needed by the proof.
readme: A source-faithful continuation of local commutative algebra. See the matching reader document for exact conventions, corrected source statements and checkpoint coverage. Generic local cohomology and secant/depth/CM theory remain in R03.3; normalized ordinary-ring dualizing complexes are requested from AS.1; scheme blowups and affine charts are imported from StableReduction Layer 4 and module strict transforms from AdicCoefficientsAndComparisons L5.

stages.title: CM-secant sequences and annihilators
stages.description: Define the local-cohomology annihilator product and CM-secant sequences; compare with imported secant and CM conditions, including empty support. Prove Schenzel’s torsion bound, extension to parameters, reversed p-standard comparison, the normalized-duality annihilator identity, the CM-locus equality for equidimensional support and the general defect-set formula.

stages.title: Huneke d-sequences and power intersections
stages.description: Define d-sequences on arbitrary modules over commutative rings. Prove the corrected torsion/colon characterization with r_j rather than r_i, native weak-regular compatibility and the two separate Goto–Yamagishi intersection identities. Include zero, unit and order-sensitive tests.

stages.title: Kawasaki’s prefix-product sequence calculus
stages.description: Define products of successive prefix ideals and the unit/successor/prefix formulas. Prove Proposition 3.11 in its three separate clauses: reversed d-sequences after auxiliary secant quotients, power-torsion equality, and regularity lifting for the last auxiliary parameter. Prove robustness under those quotients.

stages.title: Rees modules and module blowing-ups
stages.description: Construct the graded Rees module over the native Rees algebra and sheafify it on the imported scheme blowup. Prove chart image and exceptional-kernel formulas, agreement with the imported module strict transform, two-ideal module comparison, support identification and the Rees/Proj dimension bound. Do not rebuild scheme blowups.

stages.title: Cohen–Macaulay blowing-ups
stages.description: Prove the regular-terminal-element reduction and dimension-zero depth induction, with Claims 3.14.5 and 3.14.6 and the actual chart relation r_bT−r_a. Derive the theorem first under the weaker prefix conditions and then for CM-secant sequences. Exhibit the cited CM-ring/maximal-ideal-blowup nonexample.
